q: How many orders were placed in 2025?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y',order_date)='2025'
SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*p.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

q: Which region has the highest revenue?
gold: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*p.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) r FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1

q: Number of customers in each segment
gold: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY segment

q: Top 5 customers by number of orders
gold: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC, customer_id LIMIT 5
SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*p.unit_price*(1-oi.discount) - oi.quantity*p.unit_cost),2) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

q: Average discount given in each category
gold: SELECT p.category, ROUND(AVG(oi.discount),4) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

q: How many orders used each ship mode?
gold: SELECT ship_mode, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY ship_mode

q: Which sub-category sold the most units?
gold: SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(oi.quantity) u FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 1

q: List the number of customers per state, highest first
gold: SELECT state, COUNT(*) n FROM customers GROUP BY state ORDER BY n DESC
